 Print Kiara Advani reveals Karan Johar pushed Shahid Kapoor off the stage at her wedding with Sidharth Malhotra in new ‘Koffee With Karan 9’ promo The makers of ‘ Koffee With Karan ’ have released a new promo, and the next guests on Karan Johar’s chat show are Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra . The short clip shows the couple talking about their wedding, married life and the ways they keep the romance going. Kiara Advani recalls a funny wedding moment
 In the promo, Karan Johar described the couple’s wedding as “so special”. Kiara Advani remembered that Shahid Kapoor joined Karan on stage while he was performing at the celebration, to keep him company. She added that Karan later pushed Shahid off the stage. Sidharth Malhotra’s witty reply on off-screen roles
 Things got cheekier when Karan asked whether the two carry any film characters into their personal lives. Sidharth replied, “We don’t want to bring work home and definitely not into our bedroom.” Karan also asked how they make sure date nights go beyond dinner. Kiara, who is expecting her second child with Sidharth, rested a hand on her baby bump and said, “Bas ab humara, we wrap it up at dinner.” The makers shared the promo with a caption that read, “Their Koffee manifestations came true, and now there’s a whole new chapter to catch up on.” Sidharth Malhotra’s earlier ‘manifestation’ on the couch
 During Season 7 of the show in 2022, Karan Johar played a clip from Kiara’s episode for Sidharth, in which she called them “more than close friends”. Asked about marriage, Sidharth smiled and said he was “manifesting a happier and brighter future.” Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra’s love story
 The two grew close while working on ‘Shershaah’. In the 2021 film, Sidharth played Captain Vikram Batra, and Kiara played his love interest, Dimple Cheema. They kept their relationship mostly private and married on 7 February 2023 in an intimate ceremony at Suryagarh Palace in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan. On ‘Koffee With Karan’ Season 8, Kiara shared that Sidharth proposed during a family holiday in Rome and that he recreated a dialogue from ‘Shershaah’ while doing so. The couple announced their first pregnancy in February 2025 and welcomed a baby girl, Saraayah Malhotra, in July 2025. On 7 October 2026, they announced that they were expecting their second child.
